_doc: Generated by game/tools/sprite_pipeline.gd (FLEET_PACK.md T-016). Schema: id, name, tbd, world_height (DESIGN.md section 5 body-size table, SR-2; null where the section gives the enemy no row), animations[] {name, fps, loop, frames[] (paths relative to this folder), body_rect[] (tight bbox of alpha > 16 per frame, the HITBOXES shape), world_height per animation/frame where it differs}, sources[] = the ENEMIES.md 'Attachment mapping' state. Resourced at res://content/enemies/<id>/sprites.json.

anim._doc: T-083 (research/fable-tickets.md section 1.8 - the table is the spec; ENEMIES.md frozen, D-040). One entry per state of the section 1.8 table. Frames are file names relative to this folder: the T-016 names cycle_00..02 (the finger, the spec's toucher_00..02) and floor_00..04 (the glitched-floor decal, the spec's glitchfloor_00..04 - a section 2.2 world decal, not a body state). All art is TBD placeholders today (tbd=true), so every state uses the TBD frames and the timings stay exactly as the table says. Driven by the SIM state and its tick counter, never a wall-clock timer.

attack_infect.timing_note: on the infection tick; new tiles appear per section 2.2 (alpha 0 -> 1 over 12 ticks, tear flash danger red for 6 ticks, decal cycles at 8 fps with (x+z) mod 5 offset, life 12 s / 18 s from level 14, last 60 ticks flicker at 10 Hz then alpha -> 0 over 12 ticks; ben's ring cleanses within 8 u)

attack_touch.timing_note: table: 'contact kills on overlap' - no attack frame, no timing; the kill resolves on the overlap tick

idle_chase.timing_note: loop at 10 fps (6 ticks per frame); the finger always points at the player (the sprite may be mirrored horizontally; it is never rotated)

recover.timing_note: table: no recovery state; the infection cycle is continuous (every 120 ticks)

spawn.timing_note: common fade (section 1.0): alpha 0 -> 1 over 30 ticks, scale 0.8 -> 1.0; the body cannot touch or kill until the fade completes

params.pulse: the 18 ticks before each infection (infection every 120 ticks = 2.0 s, binding)

telegraph.timing_note: glitch pulse: toucher_00..02 at 20 fps (3 ticks per frame), one-shot, the 18 ticks before each infection; infection every 120 ticks = 2.0 s (binding)
